experimental_method: Vibrating-tube flow densimeter measuring density differences between solutions and pure water, 278.15-318.15 K, 0.1 mol/kg to saturation.
uncertainties_stated: Densimeter relative precision 3e-6, relative accuracy 5e-6; bath set to 0.002 K (quartz thermometer calibrated vs Pt resistance thermometer, IPTS-68); fit standard errors < 25e-6 g/cm3.
quality_remarks: Solution molalities of stocks by titration (AgNO3, BaCl2) or drying to dryness (NaCl); dilutions by mass with buoyancy corrections. Duplicated points printed in MgCl2 blocks.
not_extracted_tables: Table 2: literature density sources list (no data)
Table 4: partial molar volumes at infinite dilution (derived)
Table 5, 6, 7: fit coefficients for apparent/partial molar volumes (model parameters)
Apparent molar volumes in the text/figures are derived, not tabulated as data

row_counts.Table 1: printed 368 data rows in 19 blocks; written 368 + 19 label rows

extraction_notes: Paper is the first of a series; it measures density differences only; mapping property rho_diff with reference pure water (Kell) at same T. Tables mix in-scope salts (NaCl, MgCl2, Na2SO4) and MgSO4; all kept. Minus the Delta rho values scaled by 1e-3 in the column header 10^3 Delta rho.
